Dealer Standards: Jerome to send the overview and heat-map tool. Shelly to consider completing Section E (vehicle sales). Notes cite UMI network 60.9% vs 74.8% network average, mainly incomplete Section E.
SPA: Shelly to propose part numbers, estimated 12-month quantities, and UMI target prices. ISZE reviews and seeks management approval. No ISZE price on this screen.

R&M / fleet tenders: UMI to review the Electric Company of Israel tender and tell ISZE if special-pricing support is needed. May 2026: Nadav confirmed UMI would attend the Real Garant briefing (Bart on copy).
Sales-to-dealer extract: ISZE asked monthly part-level from 1 January 2025 (part number, invoice date, quantity; prices not required). UMI will review the request internally.

27 Oct 2025 minutes (still on file): lubricant wide-container supply to be reassessed; Jerome to wait before open lubricant orders; Sarah to refresh KPI reporting with Nadav; Jerome to send competitive-parts breakdown. Not restated on 12 Aug — older than the notes above.

lcv_peer_set.formula: LCV share = (V19 CY2025 LCV units × €250 ISZE-net rate) ÷ (that LCV wallet + LD/MD/F-Series × v9 base rates). Peer = share ≥ 90%. IBX is BELGIUM / sold-to 90 — included when it qualifies. Complete-CY billed euros (credits out) stamp book size; sales lines have no vehicle segment so SKU-level LCV billed cannot be split. Turkey and MIDI are not ISZE distributors and are not in the set. UMI 1797 is never blended with UTI 1799.
